summary.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
summary.primary_objective: Amends and consolidates laws relating to wages and bonus and matters connected therewith; guarantees statutory minimum wages and timely payment to all employees across India.
enforcing_spheres: Central Sphere (Railways, Mines, Oilfields, Major Ports)
mandatory_registers: Form C - Register of Recovery / Deductions

sections.title: Fixation of Minimum Rates of Wages
sections.statutory_text: The appropriate Government shall fix a minimum rate of wages for time work, piece work, and guaranteed time rate. The minimum wage shall be based on skill category (unskilled, semi-skilled, skilled, highly skilled), arduousness of work, and geographical area, and shall not be less than the national floor level minimum wage fixed by the Central Government.

thresholds.criterion: All wage-earning employees in all organized and unorganized establishments
thresholds.enforcing_authority: Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) / State Labour Commissioners

penalties.subsequent_offense: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to ₹1,00,000 or both

sections.title: Payment of Minimum Rate of Wages
sections.statutory_text: Where an employee is employed in an establishment where minimum rates of wages have been fixed under this Code, the employer shall pay to every employee wages at a rate which shall not be less than the minimum rate of wages so fixed. No deduction other than permissible under Section 18 shall reduce wages below the statutory minimum rate.

penalties.subsequent_offense: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 and imprisonment up to 3 months

sections.title: Wages for Overtime Work
sections.statutory_text: Where an employee whose minimum rate of wages has been fixed under this Code works on any day in excess of the number of hours constituting a normal working day, the employer shall pay him for every hour or for part of an hour so worked in excess at the overtime rate which shall not be less than twice the normal rate of wages.

thresholds.criterion: Work performed beyond normal 8 hours/day or 48 hours/week

penalties.subsequent_offense: Fine up to ₹1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 3 months

mandatory_registers: Form B - Register of Wages (Overtime Column)

sections.title: Deductions from Wages
sections.statutory_text: Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force, there shall be no deductions from the wages of an employee except those authorised under this Code (fines, absence from duty, house accommodation, recovery of advances, income tax, provident fund, insurance). The total amount of deductions which may be made in any wage period shall not exceed 50 per cent of such wages.

thresholds.criterion: Aggregate deductions in any wage period

penalties.subsequent_offense: Fine up to ₹40,000 or imprisonment up to 1 month

mandatory_registers: Form C - Register of Deductions / Fines

sections.title: Maintenance of Registers, Records and Wage Slips
sections.statutory_text: Every employer shall maintain a register containing the details of persons employed (Form A), muster roll (Form D), register of wages (Form B) and deductions (Form C) in such form and manner as prescribed, and shall issue wage slips to all employees electronically or physically in Form V.

thresholds.criterion: All establishments employing 1 or more workers

penalties.subsequent_offense: Fine up to ₹40,000 or imprisonment up to 1 month
